findings.claim: Reported memory checks support bounded native engineering acceptance; TTL governs search visibility until sweep, not immediate access revocation.
Supervision evidence covers termination of a local synthetic process tree; provider cancellation and Mac hosting remain untested.

limitations: Packet claims were not independently verified.
The as_of date represents ingestion time, not historical source availability; reporting periods and amendments are unspecified.
Historical simulation and future dedicated paper-trading acceptance remain unestablished.
Nanosecond replay is synthetic and uses integer times and opaque text.
Repository counts and selected source sections do not establish universal quality or complete source coverage.
No net token savings were measured.
These results establish neither actual broker fills nor alpha; no broker orders or live authority are evidenced.
